identity.operation: print_value prints a cJSON_Raw child of an array or object
identity.condition: A valid supported input and setup contains a cJSON_Raw child.
identity.capability: Reach Raw child printing through array or object child delegation.
identity.consequence: The harness cannot exercise that Raw child printing path.

requirement: If Raw children are within this target’s supported print inputs, a valid input and setup must reach printing of a Raw child.

assessment.necessity_reason: Both versions support constructing a Raw item, adding it to an array or object, and printing it as a child. A finite valid JSON input can supply the container and Raw text for such a setup. The complete parser dispatch produces no Raw item, and the complete old harness has no construction or insertion step, so no fuzzer input reaches this supported print behavior.

before.requirement: A valid input and supported setup containing a cJSON_Raw array or object child must be able to reach Raw child printing.
before.reason: The printer supports Raw and delegates array and object children to it. The parser dispatch cannot produce Raw, and the harness prints only the parser result.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array printing delegates each child to print_value.
Object printing delegates each child to print_value.
The public constructor creates a Raw item from supplied text.
The public object helper provides a supported setup with a Raw child.
The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case.
Array child parsing uses that dispatch.
Object child parsing uses that dispatch.

after.requirement: A valid input and supported setup containing a cJSON_Raw array or object child must be able to reach Raw child printing.
after.reason: Raw printing and child delegation remain supported. The parser still cannot produce Raw, and the fixed harness still prints only the parser result.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same parser-only item provenance blocks Raw-child printing on both sides. The selected changes add nesting guards but do not change that provenance or the Raw print contract.

necessity_evidence.reason: Raw child printing is a supported behavior of the target’s print operation, but the old harness prints only parser-produced trees. The complete parser dispatch cannot produce Raw, and the harness never constructs or inserts one. The same blocker exists before and after the nesting-guard changes, so this obligation is preexisting.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: Input bytes 0000{"r":1.00}\0 pass the harness gates and supply a valid object. A supported setup would add a Raw child with text "1.00" using cJSON_AddRawToObject, then print the object; Raw printing preserves 1.00. The old harness instead prints its parser-produced Number child and has no step that creates the Raw child.

scope_contract.reason: Printing a cJSON object is a primary target operation. Its source contract accepts Raw child values and delegates object children to the Raw-capable value printer; the public helper supplies a valid Raw-child setup.

evidence.dependency_reason: The public helper constructs and inserts a Raw object child.
The same supported Raw-child setup existed before.

feasible_trigger.reason: A valid object and Raw text have a finite supported setup. The witness input passes the harness gates, but its actual setup supplies only the parsed object to printing.

evidence.dependency_reason: Creates a Raw item from finite text.
Adds that item as an object child.

observable_consequence.reason: Raw printing copies its text verbatim, so a Raw child containing 1.00 has a distinct supported print result. The harness cannot reach that behavior because it prints only the parser result.

evidence.dependency_reason: Object printing delegates the child to Raw-capable printing.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete parser dispatch has no Raw-producing case; array and object child parsing both use that dispatch. The complete harness has no construction, insertion, or other print route. A parsed Number or String is not an equivalent route to Raw printing.

evidence.dependency_reason: Array children use the exhaustive parser dispatch.
Object children use the exhaustive parser dispatch.

identity_preserved.reason: The same Raw-child print tuple and parser-only harness route apply on both source versions. The changed array and object printers add nesting guards but retain child delegation.

evidence.dependency_reason: Before-change array printing delegates child values.
After-change array printing retains child delegation.
Before-change object printing delegates child values.
After-change object printing retains child delegation.
Before-change parser dispatch cannot create Raw.
After-change parser dispatch cannot create Raw.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Print a cJSON_Raw child of an object or array verbatim.
coverage_witness.required_setup: Construct or insert a Raw child, for example cJSON_AddRawToObject(object, "r", "1.00"), before printing.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: Parse input into a tree and pass that tree directly to a print function.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: Printing the Raw child through object or array child delegation.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None: the parser cannot produce Raw and the harness has no construction or insertion call.
